name: specter-arena
description: Turn your Kiro Crew agents into Specters and watch their work unfold as battles across a haunted arena. XP is credited as tasks end cleanly. The screenshots use demo data.
author: burlabs
highlights: Assign each bot a Specter: Vell, Stitch, Reeve, Rattle, Ember, Shard, Poly, Tide, Lume, Moss or bur.
Observed bot tasks appear as minions on the map, sized by how long each has run.
XP is credited automatically when a task ends cleanly. It reflects observed activity, not verified outcomes.
A live arena with lanes and jungle, two-way battles between heroes and minions, and recaps of today, yesterday or this week.
A Specters showcase with Attack and Cast previews against a practice target.
Runs on your machine. It does not read bot memory, notes or goals, and never changes a bot.
useCases: Watch what your Crew bots are doing as a game: a hero per bot, a minion per task, XP as work ends cleanly.
See at a glance which bots are working, which have no turn running, and where monitoring has gaps.
configuration: No setup. On your first visit the app walks you through assigning a Specter to each bot, or randomizes them for you.
Permissions: calls to its own backend, the bot list from /api/agents, and the slots:user event.
The screenshots use demo data, not live Crew activity.
